title: Cyclic Harvest
prompt:
**Problem.** A circular field of n plots with yields a[i] (may be
negative). Choose a non-empty contiguous arc maximizing the total yield.
Print that maximum.

**Constraints:** 1 <= n <= 200000; |a[i]| <= 1e4.

The seam is the whole problem: the best arc may wrap.

tests.name: wrap beats straight
tests.hint: Best straight run is 14; wrapping through the seam drops the -1: total 14 - (-1) = 15.

tests.name: all negative
tests.hint: Wrap formula must not fire when every element is negative: answer is the max element.

tests.name: no wrap needed
tests.hint: Straight 5-2+5 = 10; wrap gives 8 - (-2) = 10 too — same answer.
